description: How travelers, corporate bookers, hotels, and hosts relate to each other: who books whom, how payments settle into partner payouts, who services the stay, and which review loops drive partner visibility.

relationTypes.name: Commercial
relationTypes.description: Booking rooms and rentals through the marketplace

relationTypes.name: Operational
relationTypes.description: Confirming, servicing, and recovering stays day to day

relationTypes.name: Financial
relationTypes.description: Guest payments, partner payouts, and corporate billing

relationTypes.name: Information
relationTypes.description: Reviews and quality signals that shape ranking and demand

relations.name: Books hotel rooms
relations.description: Discovers, compares, and books hotel rooms at the rates and availability the hotel distributes through the marketplace.

relations.name: Books holiday rentals
relations.description: Books homes and apartments listed by independent hosts, agreeing to house rules and cancellation terms at checkout.

relations.name: Books policy-compliant work stays
relations.description: Books hotel stays for business trips within company policy and negotiated rate rules, on behalf of traveling colleagues.

relations.name: Pays stays settled to hotel payouts
relations.description: Pays for the stay at booking or checkout; the marketplace collects, deducts commission, and settles the payout to the hotel.

relations.name: Pays rentals settled to host payouts
relations.description: Pays for the rental through platform checkout; funds are held and released to the host as a payout after check-in, net of fees.

relations.name: Confirms and services reservations
relations.description: Confirms bookings, handles modifications and special requests, and delivers the stay from check-in to checkout.

relations.name: Hosts guests and handles requests
relations.description: Communicates arrival details, hands over the property, and resolves guest questions and issues during the stay.

relations.name: Coordinates changes and cancellations
relations.description: Manages date changes, cancellations, and rebookings with hotels when business trips shift, keeping travelers covered and costs controlled.

relations.name: Writes reviews that drive host visibility
relations.description: Rates and reviews completed stays; scores feed the ranking and trust signals that determine how much demand a host's listing earns.
